description: Installation of photovoltaic solar panels to the house's two storey rear outrigger and rear and side roof dormer extension roofs.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Unreferenced Existing Elevations; Unreferenced Existing Plans; Unreferenced Proposed Elevations; Unreferenced Proposed Layout  Received:  11 November 2022;  Unreferenced Location Plan  Received:  15 July 2022) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The eleven photovoltaic solar panels hereby approved shall not be re-installed to alternative positions on the house's roofs without the prior written approval of the Local Planning Authority.
